intro.text: In this short tutorial, you'll create and save your first invoice in Acme Billing.

s01.0.text: Start on the sign in page and enter your work email.

s02.0.text: Your invoices are listed here. To make a new one, click New invoice.

s02.3.text: And enter the price. The total updates as you type.

s02.4.text: Check the total, then save the invoice.

s03.0.text: Your new invoice now sits at the bottom of the list, marked as a draft.

s03.1.text: And the outstanding amount already includes it.

outro.text: That's it. You've created your first invoice.
